title: The Hollowing Creeps Up
description: You put the deep dead back to rest, but Father Osric is grimmer than ever. Since you cleared the galleries the grip has climbed UP — bones are breaking the churchyard sod in daylight now, above the crypt entirely. The Hollowing is not spent; it is spreading. Walk the graves, and put down whatever has clawed its way to the surface before the village sees it.

objectives.desc: Walk the churchyard graves for fresh-broken sod
Put down the risen breaking ground in daylight
